enchantment.more_enchanted.canopy_leap.d: Increases jump height on foliage and prevents fall damage when landing on leaves or shelf mushrooms.
enchantment.more_enchanted.cushioning.de: Bounces the player upward and completely absorbs all fall damage at the cost of boot durability.
enchantment.more_enchanted.timber.desc: Fells entire trees in a single strike based on enchantment level.
enchantment.more_enchanted.campfire_vita: Restores health and stops hunger depletion while resting near campfires or abandoned camps.
enchantment.more_enchanted.forager.desc: Yields extra food, saplings, seeds, and rare golden apples when harvesting wilderness foliage.
enchantment.more_enchanted.autumn_gale.d: Unleashes gusts of wind and autumnal leaves on heavy hits, pushing foes back and slowing them.
enchantment.more_enchanted.spore_burst.d: Releases a lingering cloud of toxic mushroom spores that poisons nearby enemies.
enchantment.more_enchanted.vampiric_stri: Siphons life force from living victims to restore the wielder's health.
enchantment.more_enchanted.solar_wrath.d: Inflicts extra radiant damage and ignites undead fiends under open sunlight.
enchantment.more_enchanted.magnetic_reac: Magnetically pulls dropped items and experience orbs towards the player.
enchantment.more_enchanted.curse_of_rust: Causes tools and armor to deteriorate twice as fast when immersed in water or rain.
enchantment.more_enchanted.curse_of_spor: Blinds the wearer with dense spores upon suffering combat damage.
